_frozen_from: CI run 36481897936, commit f0a3648, 2026-09-28. First baseline whose families_served is MEASURED rather than inferred.
_why_refrozen: The previous baseline (n=23, tier_accuracy 0.6316) predated two fixes that landed together in PR #110. (1) The failover chain was reordered: Gemini had been appended after five OpenRouter entries, and OpenRouter's free pool is capped at 50 requests/day account-wide, so every call spent five doomed hops before reaching a provider that answers in ~0.9s. (2) The scoring output schema was bounded: requirement_map asked for one object per JD requirement, making output length unbounded, so responses were truncated mid-JSON and the job was dropped entirely -- 10 of 25 cases. Errors fell 10 -> 1 and tier_accuracy 0.60 -> 0.85.
_families_served_caveat: This run was served entirely by Gemini: Groq's 8k TPM ceiling was exhausted by the eval itself. That is representative of current CI behaviour, not of a degraded pool. pool_shrank() compares family identity via set difference, not just count, so a later run served only by Groq is correctly reported INCONCLUSIVE rather than as a quality regression -- the two would be measuring providers against each other, not the change under review.
_guard_pass_rate_is_a_known_defect: 0.92 is NOT noise and is NOT an improvement on the previous baseline's 1.00. Two of 25 cases fail guards (254a4d0d9cf0, 3e7c3b204fd5), both tailor cases, both emitting a resume missing required sections: experience, education, projects, certifications and skills across the two. A tailored resume with no experience section is broken output. It is frozen at the measured value only so the gate stays usable -- a baseline nothing can meet trains people to ignore a red gate, which is worse than no gate. Treat 0.92 as a ratchet to raise, never as a target, and do not re-freeze a lower one without naming why here.
_gate_note: guard_pass_rate is gated from 2026-09-28 with GUARD_TOLERANCE = 0.02, tighter than ACCURACY_TOLERANCE = 0.05. A tier score is a sampled judgement and its tolerance absorbs real noise; a guard is a deterministic check that fired or did not, so the only thing its slack absorbs is the golden set's case mix shifting.
